title: Ah Sh*t, Here We Go Again
blurb: Carl Johnson steps off a plane in 2004, gets shaken down within four minutes, and sighs a line that has outlived the console it launched on. GTA San Andreas gave the internet the definitive expression of a problem you have already solved once before. It maps onto Monday mornings, the family group chat reopening an old argument, and the printer being out of ink for the third time this month. All of it is Grove Street business now. Perfectly calibrated for life's reruns, and one of gaming's most quoted lines.
origin: CJ's iconic line from Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas' opening mission.
